stem: Who is the author of the book "Tahqiq-i-Hind"?
expl: "Tahqiq-i-Hind" is a historical work written by the 10-11th century A.D. Persian historian and scholar Al-Biruni. Tahqiq-i-Hind is one of his notable works, where he provided a detailed account of the history, Geography and culture of India.

stem: Amir Khusrau was born in :
expl: Abul Hasan Yaminuddin Khusrau was known as Amir Khusrau. He was born at Patiyali in district Etah (now named Kasganj) in 1253 A.D. Khusrau was called “Tuti-i-Hind” (Parrot of India). He started composing poems at an early age of nine. His fi rst Masnavi on the historical subject was Qiran-us-Sadain. Miftah-ul-Futuh, Khazain-ul-Futuh, Ashika, Nuh Sipihr, Tughluq Namah etc. were the major creations of Amir Khusrau. Tughluq Namah is the last historical Masnavi of Amir Khusrau.

stem: Which of the following works was written by Ziauddin Barani?
expl: Ziauddin Barani was a Muslim political philosopher of the Delhi Sultanate. He wrote two famous works, "Tarikh-i-Firuzshahi" and "Fatwa-i-Jahandari." expl: Tabaqat-i-Nasiri is a medieval text by Minhaj-us-Siraj. It is an important sourcebook for the reconstruction of the history of the foundation of Muslim rule in Bengal.
